definitions.explanation: A test administered to job applicants as part of a hiring process, assessing knowledge, aptitude, or suitability. Common for companies, government offices, and schools.

examples.japanese: {採用試験|さいようしけん}を{受|う}ける。
{公務員|こうむいん}の{採用試験|さいようしけん}は{難|むずか}しい。
examples.english: The civil-service hiring exam is difficult.

examples.japanese: {採用試験|さいようしけん}に{合格|ごうかく}して、{来月|らいげつ}から{働|はたら}くことになった。
examples.english: I passed the hiring exam and will start working next month.

notes:
Composed of {採用|さいよう} (adoption, hiring) + {試験|しけん} (examination). Refers to the whole screening test used to decide whom to employ, which may include written tests, essays, and interviews.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {採用試験|さいようしけん}に{合格|ごうかく}する: to pass the hiring exam
- {採用試験|さいようしけん}に{落|お}ちる: to fail the hiring exam
- {採用試験|さいようしけん}を{実施|じっし}する: to hold a hiring exam

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {入社|にゅうしゃ}{試験|しけん}: company entrance exam — specifically for joining a company
- {面接|めんせつ}: interview — one component of the process
